text:
[LSCP.2.4.1] Facts are asserted by an `emit` in a rule's
activation RHS and retracted on every completion path of that
activation: synchronous end of RHS, every `after` timer
fire per [LTAC], every `on response` match, every `on timeout`
fire, every `on error` fire per [LCCO]. A capture fact of a call with more than
one `timeout` clause is not retracted by a `timeout` fire ([LCCO.7.3]).

A path that can no longer complete discharges the facts it carries. When the
token fact carrying a deferred path, a timer or a capture, is superseded by an
`as`-keyed re-fire ([LRST.2.2]) or otherwise withdrawn before it fires, the
engine **must** retract the activation's facts attached to that path at that
withdrawal, as it would have at the path's completion; a fact attached to
more than one path is retracted once, when the first of them ends. The
withdrawal's cause is `ACTIVATION_COMPLETED` ([RFCS.7a.2]).
